source.derivation: Only committed scope-ledger.json.sourceExposure.rows supplies current adapter states; the actual READ_FAMILIES operationIds subsets and canonical bindings independently reproduce generalRegistration. Historical top-level ledger counts are not current source status.

definitions.complete: Canonical source adapter covers the operation and is SDK-registered; current authority, source installation and all runtime gates remain required.
definitions.partial: An implemented bounded input/resource branch or pending native bridge leaves the complete operation and SDK exposure held.
definitions.absent: No canonical source adapter is declared for this operation.
definitions.familyStatus: complete only if every selected source operation is complete; absent only if every selected source operation is absent; otherwise partial. Family partial includes mixed complete/absent coverage.
definitions.sdkExposed: Static source registration only; this does not establish runtime availability or qualification.
definitions.qualification: No read is claimed qualified or live by this source-only snapshot.
